title: FIPS gate present in kcapi callbacks: must be removed
description: The kcapi provider sets fips_gate=NULL in every ops table (is_fips=0). Per CLAUDE.md section 1d, kcapi callbacks must NOT manually call any gate function. Audited: kcapi_aead.c, kcapi_hash.c, kcapi_kdf.c, kcapi_skcipher.c. No manual gate calls were found in any kcapi callback. This item is filed for completeness to document the negative finding.
close_reason: Not a violation: kcapi callbacks correctly contain no gate calls. Filed in error as tracking of negative audit finding.
